comment: Pictures 1-2 are a photo of the original pedal. The post has two vero layouts, alternative versions: 'EHX Green Russian Big Muff' (third picture) and 'EHX Green Russian Big Muff V7 1994' (fifth picture, different values); the first/main one was read. The Scooped / Flat / Boosted mids switch inset (3 pos DPDT carrying a 4n7 and a 10n between Tone 3 and Sw1) is drawn as part of the build and its switch and two caps are included.
uncertain: 4n in the centre of the board: printed clearly, unusual value
